info.name: Eczema

info.name: Psoriasis
info.desc: Well-demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale.

info.name: Contact dermatitis
info.desc: Irritant or allergic eczematous reaction to contact.

info.name: Systemic autoimmune
info.desc: Cutaneous signs of systemic autoimmune disease (e.g. lupus).

decision_support.headline: Refer to a dermatologist — the five classifiers disagree about this photo
decision_support.disclaimer: Research prototype — not a medical device. Does not provide a diagnosis. Always confirm with a qualified clinician.

unified.malignancy_source: dedicated malignancy head (clinical cancer photos; threshold set for 90% sensitivity)

measures.name: Marked area
measures.note: the region the first diagnosis relied on most

measures.name: Colour against the skin around it
measures.note: CIELAB colour difference; about 2 is just noticeable

measures.name: Asymmetry
measures.note: 0 means the area matches its mirror image

measures.name: Colour variation inside
measures.note: spread of lightness (L*) inside the area

measures.name: Surface texture
measures.note: fine detail (edges) inside, relative to the surrounding skin

lesion_map.note: The evidence is spread over much of the photograph, as in a widespread eruption, so the marked area is only its strongest part. Measurements of the marked area, for orientation; the classifiers do not use them.
